# Ripe potatoes

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-potato-plant-3.md" title="Ripe potatoes"><img src="icons/36.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Ripe potatoes"></a>

Ripe potatoes are stage 4 of the potato crop. Harvest for **2–4 potatoes**.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Placement | World block; cannot be placed directly as an inventory item |

## How to obtain

Find wild ripe crops on grassy ground, or let flowering potatoes finish growing.

## Using it

Use harvested potatoes for food or replanting.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
